verdict.rationale: The docs describe SDKs and a CLI built for agentic workflows. They let an agent create sandboxes, run commands in blocking or detached mode, stream logs and manage files. Auth is automatic on Vercel or uses access tokens elsewhere, and sandboxes stop automatically on timeout, so the loop can run without a human. Missing for 10: an explicit programmatic stop/delete API call (only dashboard stop and timeout are shown, and stopping persists state by default rather than destroying it), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the full end-to-end flow.
